title: Are LLMs the Master of All Trades? : Exploring Domain-Agnostic Reasoning Skills of LLMs
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component dedicated to evaluating moral and ethical reasoning. It features a specific methodology section (2.3), a results section (3.3), and a detailed appendix (Appendix C) containing moral dilemmas such as downloading copyrighted material and following unjust laws to test the model's ethical judgment.
